rationale: C103 flagged negative fair_value values, but the raw September 30, 2024 schedule of investments reports parenthesized negative amounts in the Fair Value column for the same types of unfunded revolver/delayed-draw positions. The extracted negatives are source-faithful rather than data errors; the warning is therefore a rule-scope false alarm for legitimate negative fair values.
